body:
Code Review by Qodo


View medium (3)
1. PR body is missing corpus evidence 📎 Requirement gap
>
>Description >
> >
>The PR description has no ## Corpus check section, so the head totals line, the full A hit list,
>the CollabPresence.vue, ThemeCompactPicker.vue and Form.vue clearance confirmations, and the
>DeleteButton.vue:67 B-hit note are all absent. The added CI step gates on these same hits, so
>reviewers cannot verify the corpus run that the check relies on.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The PR body for the runtime-cost check (#3910) has no `## Corpus check` section. The checklist requires the head totals line, the full list of A hits, a clearance confirmation for each of the three CollabPresence.vue, ThemeCompactPicker.vue and Form.vue hits, and a note that B includes crouton-core/app/components/DeleteButton.vue:67. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- .github/workflows/ci.yml[353-357] > >## Recommended Fix >Edit the PR description (not the code) to add a `## Corpus check` section. Run `node scripts/check-runtime-cost.mjs` on the current tree to obtain the head totals line `[runtime-cost] files=… A=… B=… allowed=…`. List every A hit with file:line and tag, and confirm each of the three cleared hits in CollabPresence.vue, ThemeCompactPicker.vue and Form.vue. Add the DeleteButton.vue:67 B-hit note. Do not add allow-comments to existing files or touch packages/, apps/ or pocs/. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/07b30c5c-23a1-4edd-a0dc-e52f00344863?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/07b30c5c-23a1-4edd-a0dc-e52f00344863)
2. Touch users cannot open some popovers 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>hoverOnlyReason treats any enable-touch binding as a touch fallback because hasProp checks for
>the prop's presence, not its value. A new <UPopover mode="hover" :enable-touch="false"> therefore
>contributes no hover-only hit and passes the PR gate even though tapping its trigger cannot open it.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A syntactically present but false `enable-touch` binding exempts a hover popover from the check. >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/check-runtime-cost.mjs[59-63] >- scripts/check-runtime-cost.mjs[94-96] >- scripts/check-runtime-cost.deps-test.mjs[85-100] >## Recommended Fix >Exempt hover popovers only when touch support is enabled; treat a literal false binding as a hit, and add a CLI test for that case. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4130f183-dc98-41cd-a1f1-ec9d47fba8c5?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4130f183-dc98-41cd-a1f1-ec9d47fba8c5)
3. Regression output blames old overlays 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>compare passes the entire head hit list to formatRegression, which prints every entry without
>distinguishing it from baseline hits. When a file with existing overlays gains one more, the failure
>lists the old overlays as well, leaving the author unable to tell which reported line caused the
>increase.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The regression message presents all head hits as though they were newly added. >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/check-runtime-cost.mjs[151-161] >- scripts/check-runtime-cost.mjs[221-228] >- scripts/check-runtime-cost.deps-test.mjs[184-190] >## Recommended Fix >Use the base hit information to identify newly introduced locations where possible. If moved hits make attribution ambiguous, label the printed lines as all current hits rather than new hits, and test a file with an existing hit plus one added hit. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/20f43236-5deb-4e7c-9e7e-9bf264f9751f?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/20f43236-5deb-4e7c-9e7e-9bf264f9751f)
